ModuleName: 4 - Introduction to the Document Object Model (DOM)

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the lecture topics for the DOM module—covering what the DOM is, how browsers parse HTML into a DOM tree, the tree's node structure, and methods for selecting elements—serving as a navigational overview for learners and instructors to see what the module teaches.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: Lists the topics covered in the DOM module—including what the DOM is, how it structures HTML as a tree of nodes, and how JavaScript interacts with it—serving as a navigational overview that helps learners and instructors see the scope of the module at a glance.

Artifacts.Name: What is the DOM?
Artifacts.Description: A reading that introduces the Document Object Model, explaining what it is, why browsers create it from raw HTML, and how it serves as the in-memory, structured representation that JavaScript interacts with, intended for learners beginning the module.

Artifacts.Name: How Browsers Parse HTML into the DOM
Artifacts.Description: A reading that walks learners through the step-by-step process browsers use to parse raw HTML text and construct the DOM, covering tokenization, tree construction, and how the resulting structure enables JavaScript manipulation and rendering.

Artifacts.Name: The DOM Tree Structure
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains the hierarchical tree structure of the DOM — including nodes, parent-child-sibling relationships, and how HTML elements map to interconnected objects in memory — to help learners understand how the DOM is organized before working with it programmatically.

Artifacts.Name: Selecting DOM Elements
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers how to locate specific elements or groups of elements in the DOM using JavaScript selection methods such as getElementById, querySelector, and querySelectorAll, serving as a prerequisite skill before learners attempt to read or modify page content.

Artifacts.Name: Manipulating DOM Elements
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers how to read and dynamically change DOM elements using JavaScript, including modifying text content, inner HTML, attributes, CSS classes, and inline styles, intended for learners who have already learned how to select elements.

Artifacts.Name: Adding and Removing DOM Nodes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how to dynamically modify a page's structure at runtime using JavaScript, covering creating new elements, inserting, moving, replacing, cloning, and removing nodes from the DOM.

Artifacts.Name: Adding and Removing DOM Nodes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how to dynamically modify a page's structure at runtime using JavaScript, covering creating new elements, inserting, moving, replacing, cloning, and removing nodes from the DOM.
